title: BAC-4412: One org-admin check for the bank account list
author: kate-zublenko
body:
Extracts `_is_org_admin` so `get_queryset` and the balance column ask one question.

Jira: https://hoopit.atlassian.net/browse/BAC-4412

comments.body:
_🧹 Nitpick_ | _🔵 Trivial_

The comment says what the method returns; say who is narrowed instead.
Reworded in 1c0ffee: it now says who `get_queryset` narrows.

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**`_is_org_admin` compares against the requested group, not its root.**

The removed `_can_view_balance` checked `filter(pk=group.get_root().pk)`. This compares with `group.pk`, so a sub-group admin who requests the list with `group_id` set to the sub-group they manage passes as an org admin: `get_queryset` stops narrowing their accounts and the balance column and export open up to them.

```diff
-        return self.get_user().get_admin_groups().filter(pk=group.pk).exists()
+        return self.get_user().get_admin_groups().filter(pk=group.get_root().pk).exists()
```

_🛠️ Refactor suggestion_ | _🟡 Minor_

**The export still reads the old helper.**

`resource_class` builds the export with `self._can_view_balance()`, which this PR otherwise replaces with `_is_org_admin`. Switch it too, so the export and the JSON list cannot drift.
